(1) a combination of a gated recurrent unit (GRU) and attention mechanism can generate better summaries than a long short-term memory (LSTM) network; (2) the beam search decoding algorithm outperforms the greedy decoding; and (3) a hybrid model that combines the encoder of the pointer generator network (PGN) and the decoder of a sequence-to-sequence attention-based neural network (Seq2Seq-Attn) is the best model for abstractive summarization.
